name: ConsoleProgressKit
description: ConsoleProgressKit Swift API reference for showing progress in command-line tools — live spinners, progress bars, and plain log lines on stderr. USE WHEN using ConsoleProgressKit, ProgressDisplay, LiveProgressDisplay, PlainProgressDisplay, ActivityHandle, track(_:operation:), NoteStyle, ProgressTheme, TerminalColor, TerminalCapabilities, TerminalStream, TextStyle, TextStyler, AnsiTextStyler, PlainTextStyler, ConsoleProgressTesting, MockProgressDisplay, TaggingTextStyler, OR adding spinners, progress bars, or progress output to a Swift CLI, OR choosing their colors, OR styling a Swift CLI's final output, OR honoring NO_COLOR.
